Definition: house of Azmaveth, a place in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Beth-Azmaveth means "house of the strength of death." It was a place near Jerusalem. You will find it in Nehemiah 7:28.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Beth-Azmaveth marks real ground in God's story, not a made-up setting.
